THE SMALL PRINT

Your privacy matters.

A simple explanation of how this website works.

This website

This is a static information website. It does not include guest accounts, enquiry submission forms, payment collection, advertising trackers or analytics scripts.

Hosting

The hosting provider may process technical information, including IP addresses and request logs, to deliver and protect the website. Its privacy terms apply to that processing.

Contact and external links

If you choose to contact the host by email, phone or WhatsApp, your chosen provider processes that communication under its own terms. External websites have their own privacy practices.

Booking services

Online booking is not active on this preview. This notice must be reviewed when booking or enquiry services are added.

Contacting the operator

Operator contact information is being confirmed and will be published before launch.
